169    /**
170     * Executes the main build pipeline.
171     * 
172     * Cleans the output directory, scans content files, handles translation virtualization,
173     * and triggers generation of HTML, feeds, and static assets.
174     */
175    public function build(): void
176    {
177        $base = $this->site->paths->baseDir;
178        $themeDir = $this->site->paths->themeDir ?? 'theme';
179        $timings = [];
180        $t_start = microtime(true);
181
182        // Scan content
183        $s1 = microtime(true);
184        $this->scan($this->site->paths->getContentPath());
185        $this->ensureMandatoryHomepage();
186        $this->translationVirtualizer->virtualize($this->pages);
187
188        // Pass 2: Render Markdown to HTML now that all pages are scanned
189        global $pages, $site;
190        $pages = $this->pages;
191        $site = $this->site;
192
193        $contentProcessor = new ContentProcessor();
194        foreach ($this->pages as $page) {
195            if (isset($page->rawBody) && $page->rawBody !== '') {
196                $renderedContent = $contentProcessor->processContent($page->rawBody, $page);
197                $page->content->content = trim($renderedContent, " \n\r\t");
198            }
199        }
200
201        $s2 = microtime(true);
202        $timings['Scan + Virtualize'] = ($s2 - $s1) * 1000;
203
204        // Generate files
205        if (isset($this->site->options->skipPages) && $this->site->options->skipPages) {
206            echo "Skipping page generation\n";
207        } else {
208            $this->generateHTMLFiles();
209        }
210        $s3 = microtime(true);
211        $timings['Generate HTML/GMI/Gopher'] = ($s3 - $s2) * 1000;
212        
213        // Generate Feeds
214        $this->feedPublisher->publishFeeds($this->pages);
215        $this->compileTimelineStaticPage();
216        $this->loadThemeFeedView();
217        $s4 = microtime(true);
218        $timings['Generate Feeds'] = ($s4 - $s3) * 1000;
219
220        // Copy assets
221        $this->assetPublisher->publishViewAssets($base . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $themeDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . "views");
222        $s5 = microtime(true);
223        $timings['Copy Assets'] = ($s5 - $s4) * 1000;
224
225        // Copy Media
226        if (isset($this->site->options->skipMedia) && $this->site->options->skipMedia) {
227            echo "Skipping media files\n";
228        } else {
229            $this->assetPublisher->publishMedia();
230        }
231        $s6 = microtime(true);
232        $timings['Copy Media'] = ($s6 - $s5) * 1000;
233
234        // Copy static files
235        if ($this->site->options->skipStatic) {
236            echo "Skipping static files\n";
237        } else {
238            $this->assetPublisher->publishStaticFiles($base . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $themeDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . "static");
239        }
240        $s7 = microtime(true);
241        $timings['Copy Static Files'] = ($s7 - $s6) * 1000;
242
243        $this->assetPublisher->garbageCollect(self::$manifest);
244        $s8 = microtime(true);
245        $timings['Garbage Collect'] = ($s8 - $s7) * 1000;
246
247        $totalTime = ($s8 - $t_start) * 1000;
248
249        // Output summary table
250        echo "\n+----------------------------------+-----------------+\n";
251        echo "| Task                             | Time (ms)       |\n";
252        echo "+----------------------------------+-----------------+\n";
253        foreach ($timings as $task => $time) {
254            printf("| %-32s | %15.2f |\n", $task, $time);
255        }
256        echo "+----------------------------------+-----------------+\n";
257        printf("| %-32s | %15.2f |\n", 'TOTAL BUILD TIME', $totalTime);
258        echo "+----------------------------------+-----------------+\n";
259    }

285    /**
286     * Recursively scans a directory for markdown content files.
287     * Parses valid markdown files into Page objects and adds them to the collection.
288     * Skips system directories (e.g., app, vendor, output dirs).
289     *
290     * @param string $dir The directory path to scan.
291     * @return void
292     */
293    public function scan(string $dir): void
294    {
295        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
296            return;
297        }
298        $entries = scandir($dir);
299        if ($entries === false) {
300            return;
301        }
302
303        foreach ($entries as $entry) {
304            if (
305                $entry !== "."
306                && $entry !== ".."
307                && substr($entry, 0, 1) !== "_"
308                && substr($entry, 0, 1) !== "."
309            ) {
310                $path = $dir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $entry;
311                if (is_file($path)) {
312                    if ($entry === 'intro.md') {
313                        continue;
314                    }
315                    $page = $this->parser->parse($path);
316                    if ($page) {
317                        $this->pages->add($page);
318                    }
319                } elseif (is_dir($path)) {
320                    $baseDir = rtrim($this->site->paths->baseDir ?? '', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR);
321                    $themeDir = $this->site->paths->themeDir ?? 'theme';
322                    $ignoredDirs = [
323                        $baseDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . "app",
324                        $baseDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . "bootstrap",
325                        $baseDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . "vendor",
326                        $baseDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . "resources",
327                        $baseDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . "theme",
328                        $baseDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . "data",
329                        $baseDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $themeDir,
330                        $baseDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $this->site->paths->outputDirHtml,
331                        $baseDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $this->site->paths->outputDirGemini,
332                        $baseDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $this->site->paths->outputDirGopher,
333                        $baseDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $this->site->paths->outputDirMedia,
334                    ];
335                    $skip = false;
336                    foreach ($ignoredDirs as $ignored) {
337                        if ($path === $ignored || strpos($path, $ignored . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) === 0) {
338                            $skip = true;
339                            break;
340                        }
341                    }
342                    if (!$skip) {
343                        $this->scan($path);
344                    }
345                }
346            }
347        }
348    }

350    /**
351     * Iterates over all parsed pages and triggers the generation of HTML, 
352     * Gemini, and Gopher files for each. Also generates sitemaps and indexes.
353     *
354     * @return void
355     */
356    public function generateHTMLFiles(): void
357    {
358        $pagesByKind = [];
359        foreach ($this->pages as $page) {
360            $pagesByKind[$page->kind][] = $page;
361            $this->pagePublisher->publish($page);
362        }
363
364        // Generate Sitemap
365        $this->compileSitemap();
366
367        $allKinds = array_unique(array_merge(
368            array_keys($this->site->config['kinds'] ?? []),
369            array_keys($pagesByKind)
370        ));
371
372        foreach ($allKinds as $kind) {
373            if (in_array($kind, ['generic', 'page', 'home'])) {
374                continue;
375            }
376            $pagesForKind = $pagesByKind[$kind] ?? [];
377            if (empty($pagesForKind)) {
378                continue;
379            }
380            $config = $this->site->config['kinds'][$kind] ?? Helper::getKindConfig($kind);
381            if (isset($config['show_in_menu']) && !$config['show_in_menu']) {
382                continue;
383            }
384
385            $displayMode = $config['display_mode'] ?? 'default';
386
387            if ($displayMode === 'full_content') {
388                $this->compileTimelineIndexes($kind, $pagesForKind);
389            } else {
390                $this->compileSectionIndexes($kind, $pagesForKind);
391            }
392        }
393        
394        $this->compileTaxonomyIndexes('tag', 'tags', $this->pages);
395        $this->compileTaxonomyIndexes('flowerbed', 'flowerbed', $this->pages);
396    }

417    /**
418     * Compiles the static timeline page from subscribed feeds and hubs.
419     *
420     * @return void
421     */
422    private function compileTimelineStaticPage(): void
423    {
424        $base = $this->site->paths->baseDir;
425        $twtxtManager = new \Indieinabox\Twtxt\TwtxtManager();
426        $cacheDir = $base . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'data' . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'twtxt_cache';
427
428        $timelineEntries = [];
429        $mentionEntries = [];
430
431        if (!empty($this->site->twtxt->following)) {
432            $timelineEntries = $twtxtManager->fetchTimeline($this->site->twtxt->following, $cacheDir, false);
433        }
434        if (!empty($this->site->twtxt->hubs)) {
435            $mentionEntries = $twtxtManager->fetchHubMentions($this->site->twtxt->hubs, $this->site->metadata->fqdn, $cacheDir, false);
436        }
437
438        echo "Compiling timeline static page...\n";
439        $timelinePage = Page::fromArray([
440            'title' => 'Timeline',
441            'layout' => 'timeline',
442            'slug' => 'timeline/',
443            'date' => time(),
444            'content' => '',
445            'originalcontent' => ''
446        ]);
447
448        global $timeline, $mentions;
449        $timeline = $timelineEntries;
450        $mentions = $mentionEntries;
451
452        $themeDir = $this->site->paths->themeDir ?? 'theme';
453        $layoutFile = $base . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $themeDir
454            . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'views' . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'timeline.php';
455        if (file_exists($layoutFile) && is_readable($layoutFile)) {
456            $this->pagePublisher->publishHtml($timelinePage);
457        } else {
458            echo "Skipping timeline static page compilation: timeline layout not found.\n";
459        }
460    }

462    /**
463     * @param \Indieinabox\Page[] $pages
464     */
465    private function compileTimelineIndexes(string $targetKind, array $pages): void
466    {
467        $grouped = [];
468        foreach ($pages as $p) {
469            if (basename($p->filepath) === 'intro.md') {
470                continue;
471            }
472
473            $lang = $p->lang ?? 'en';
474            $date = $p->date;
475            $yearMonth = $date->format('Y-m');
476
477            $grouped[$lang][$yearMonth][] = $p;
478        }
479
480        foreach ($grouped as $lang => &$months) {
481            krsort($months);
482            foreach ($months as $yearMonth => &$monthPages) {
483                usort($monthPages, function ($a, $b) {
484                    $timeA = $a->date->getTimestamp();
485                    $timeB = $b->date->getTimestamp();
486                    return $timeB <=> $timeA;
487                });
488            }
489            unset($monthPages);
490        }
491        unset($months);
492
493        $base = $this->site->paths->baseDir;
494        $themeDir = $this->site->paths->themeDir ?? 'theme';
495        $summaryFile = $base . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $themeDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . "views"
496            . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . "includes" . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . "summary.php";

629        $defaultLang = $this->site->localization->defaultLang;

632        // Group by language

641            }

648                    return $timeB <=> $timeA;
649                });
650

658                }

667                    'kind'    => $targetKind
668                ]);
669
